_comment: Allowlist for scripts/with_env.py (wrapper syntax: `python3 -I scripts/with_env.py <name>`). The wrapper is the HUMAN's path, run directly or through `make graphify-deep`: it loads .env and runs the named command with secrets in its environment, so every entry receives them. The sandbox excludes nothing, so a sandboxed agent cannot use it (it fails on the .env deny) and MUST NOT add a sandbox.excludedCommands entry: any excluded entry lets a chained command run unsandboxed (Sprint 055 QA Gate 1 round 3 N1). The caller supplies a name, never an argv. argv[0] is a path relative to the framework checkout (the directory holding scripts/ and config/); the remaining tokens are literal. `-I` keeps a graphify/ folder in the working directory from shadowing the package. This list is nucleus-only: a host does not extend it and proposes an addition upstream through agents.md section 4 feedback_upstream. pytest is not listed because it executes agent-written code. Output masking is not a security boundary.

graphify-extract.reason: graphify semantic extraction reads its provider key from the environment only (graphifyy 0.8.30 has no .env loader)

graphify-extract-deep.reason: deep semantic extraction, same provider-key requirement

graphify-label.reason: community labelling through the provider, same provider-key requirement
